perception.ownership: Camera compiler reserves readability budgets; RevealPlan reads immutable motion

naturalMotion.relationPolicy: Short moving relation beat; no stationary RELATION_HOLD

revealPlan.policy: Geometry, actual glyph bounds, geographic speed, scale and future-safe latched candidates; no timestamp-only reveal
revealPlan.candidatePolicy: Unchanged measured Universal Layout candidates latched for the geographic beat

pipeline.composition: Frozen map factory + explicit GPU moving graphic pass in one default framebuffer
pipeline.cameraRevealOwnership: Separate immutable CameraPlan / RevealPlan / Layout contract; pure frame evaluation
pipeline.scaleVisualPolicy: Unchanged CONTINENT/REGIONAL design tokens interpolated by actual geographic viewport size

nativeContextSource.method: Exact geographic native RGB window of same admitted source; no resize/resampling/color operation/new data

graphicPass.composition: Direct GPU quad draw into the frozen map factory default framebuffer
graphicPass.fontCoverage: Actual frozen factory glyph atlases; lossless PNG coverage, unchanged metrics/style
graphicPass.shaderPolicy: Four byte-identical approved static GLSL literals
graphicPass.canvasUse: Pinned glyph coverage decode only; no rendered frame Canvas compositing

REGIONAL.projection: Regional equirectangular, standard parallel at framing center

layoutValidation.countryBoundaryClearance: Rendered core/contrast-edge half-width + 1px AA; glyph outline + 2px padding retained; faint glow tail is not a hard exclusion
layoutValidation.measurement: Actual glyph alpha bounds; source polygon interiors and screen-wide scored candidates; no content-specific coordinates

heightSource.source: User-provided Copernicus GLO-30 COG DSM originals
heightSource.orientation: north-up row-major; row 0 north, column 0 west
heightSource.unitEvidence: Copernicus GLO-30 product convention; band unit is not embedded in these TIFFs
heightSource.verticalDatum: EGM2008 per product convention, not encoded in EPSG:4326
heightSource.resampling: NONE; four bit-identical source grids stitched by geographic offsets
heightSource.sampling: 3x3 sparse footprint-aware height sampling (not exact area integration); geographic central derivatives across shared atlas; WGS84 east/north distances
heightSource.outsideCoverage: Exact Gate1A terrain path; no invented elevation

REGIONAL.sourceRelief: Copernicus GLO-30 real DSM height inside admitted footprint only; NE1 baked hillshade + Gate1A outside
graph: GPU role/land AA coverage (separate MSAA target)
terrain RGB linear decode -> region material -> relief/light -> sea -> output transfer
primary ribbon glow target -> separable blur
REGIONAL.canvasUse: glyph atlas preparation ONLY; no final-frame Canvas 2D compositing

terrainLod.method: Geographic raw terrain RGB source sampling before the unchanged linear decode/material/lighting; real-source coverage only; no completed-frame transition
